summary: A declared pre-opening sole-proprietor food stand in Shreveport, LA with no website and no observable public footprint of any kind. The Louisiana SOS commercial search could not be executed, but as an Individual no state entity registration is expected, so this is not itself a negative signal. Total risk 0 across all six dimensions, with the caveat that everything is unverified rather than positively confirmed - approval should rest on representative ID verification and the parish/city food vendor permit.
